features.definition: The primary or most prominent color of the Pokémon's body is blue or a shade of blue (0=not blue-dominant, 1=clearly blue-dominant)
The Pokémon primarily moves on four limbs (0=not quadrupedal, 1=clearly quadrupedal)
The Pokémon stands or moves primarily on two legs (0=not bipedal, 1=clearly bipedal)
The Pokémon has bird-like features such as wings, beak, feathers, or talons (0=no avian features, 1=clearly bird-like)
The Pokémon has features associated with water/aquatic life such as fins, flippers, gills, or a water-bubble (0=no aquatic features, 1=clearly aquatic-adapted)
The Pokémon is primarily inspired by a real-world mammal (canine, feline, rodent, primate, etc.) (0=not mammal-inspired, 1=clearly mammal-inspired)
The Pokémon is primarily inspired by a reptile or dinosaur (crocodile, turtle, snake, lizard, dragon, etc.) (0=not reptilian, 1=clearly reptilian)
The Pokémon has significant plant-based features such as leaves, vines, flowers, or a plant-like body (0=no plant features, 1=strongly plant-based)
The Pokémon appears robotic, mechanical, or made of metal/artificial materials (0=organic, 1=clearly mechanical/robotic)
The Pokémon has ghostly, shadowy, or supernatural/paranormal features (0=no ghost features, 1=clearly ghost-like)
The Pokémon is inspired by insects, arachnids, or other arthropods (0=not bug-inspired, 1=clearly bug/arthropod-inspired)
The Pokémon is primarily inspired by an amphibian such as a frog or salamander (0=not amphibian, 1=clearly amphibian-inspired)
The Pokémon has wings of any kind (0=no wings, 1=has wings)
The Pokémon has a horn, spike, or prominent pointed projection on its head (0=none, 1=clearly present)
The Pokémon has a humanoid body plan with distinct head, torso, and limbs resembling a person (0=not humanoid, 1=strongly humanoid)
The description implies the Pokémon is large in size (e.g., massive, long-bodied, large Pokémon) (0=small/tiny implied, 1=large/massive implied)
The Pokémon has a tail explicitly mentioned in the description (0=no tail mentioned, 1=tail explicitly present)
The Pokémon's primary coloring is in brown, orange, or earth tones (0=not earth-toned, 1=clearly brown/orange/earth-dominant)
The Pokémon has features associated with electricity such as lightning bolt shapes, electricity-generating organs, or yellow electrical markings (0=none, 1=clearly electric-themed)
The Pokémon has crystals, gems, or jewel-like structures embedded in or on its body (0=none, 1=clearly present)
The Pokémon has more than one head or distinct face visible on its body (0=single head/face, 1=multiple heads or faces)
The Pokémon has a long, snake-like or eel-like body without prominent limbs (0=not serpentine, 1=clearly serpentine/eel-like)
The primary or most prominent color of the Pokémon is green (0=not green-dominant, 1=clearly green-dominant)
The Pokémon has claws explicitly mentioned (0=no claws, 1=claws explicitly present)
The Pokémon has a compact, round, or spherical body shape (0=elongated or complex shape, 1=clearly round/compact body)

The Pokémon looks like a natural, organic creature without robotic, mechanical, or heavily supernatural elements - it resembles a real-world animal or plant (0=clearly artificial/supernatural/non-natural, 1=clearly natural-looking organic creature or plant)
The Pokémon's primary body color is gray, white, or silver (0=not gray/white dominant, 1=clearly gray or white dominant)

The Pokémon is an organic (non-robotic, non-mechanical) creature whose body coloring is dominated by warm or natural colors including green, brown, orange, red, or yellow — essentially a living creature that is not blue, gray, white, or black (0=does not fit this profile, 1=clearly a warm-colored organic Pokémon)

The Pokémon has green coloring anywhere on its body, including hair, accessories, markings, or secondary colors — not necessarily the dominant color (0=no green present, 1=clearly has green coloring somewhere on the body)

The Pokémon incorporates green plant-like elements such as leaves, vines, grass, or green organic growth as part of its design, even if not the primary body color (0=no plant/green elements, 1=clearly has green plant-like elements)

notes: The grouping criterion appears to be primarily about whether the Pokémon has green coloring (even as secondary color) vs. not. item_035 (gorilla with green hair/accessories) belongs with green Pokémon, not brown mammals. Need to boost green color detection and add a feature for 'any significant green present' to capture item_035's green hair/accessories.
